cases.case_label: Homozygous AluY insertion disrupting the CRB1 open reading frame in RP12
cases.disease: Retinitis pigmentosa 12 (autosomal recessive RP with preserved para-arteriolar retinal pigment epithelium)
cases.mechanism_detail: Among ten unrelated RP12 patients screened, one carried a homozygous AluY insertion that disrupts the CRB1 open reading frame. The abstract does not localise the insertion to a numbered exon and no transcript study is described.
cases.quote: In ten unrelated RP patients with preserved para-arteriolar RPE, we identified a homozygous AluY insertion disrupting the ORF, five homozygous missense mutations and four compound heterozygous mutations in CRB1.
